title: Check versions against ranges
prompt:
The plugin installer must check a plugin's version against the range its manifest asks for. Implement
`satisfies(version, range)` in src/semver.js for plain `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` versions and these ranges: an exact
version, `^x.y.z` (same major; for 0.y.z same minor), `~x.y.z` (same major and minor), comparators `>`, `>=`, `<`,
`<=` combined with spaces (all must hold), `||` between alternatives, and `*`. Invalid input throws a `TypeError`.
